findings.title: Israeli strikes kill 16 schoolchildren so far this month, Gaza ministry says
findings.affected_population_system: Gaza education ministry statement on November 25 reported 16 schoolchildren killed since the beginning of November. This is a cumulative ministry figure, not 16 additional fatalities or a newly occurring attack. Not independently audited.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: The number of schoolchildren killed since the beginning of November has now risen to 16.
findings.source_type: Established reporting quoting official education ministry statement

bounded_discovery_context.method: Targeted November 27 civilian-impact search; read full Guardian report, compared with 43 authenticated November 25–26 ledger files.
bounded_discovery_context.novelty: Specific schoolchild casualty aggregate absent from the reviewed ledger; first publication and underlying statement predate observation window.
bounded_discovery_context.caveat: Updated at 15:33 EST; individual incidents may overlap earlier reporting; no production comparison.

findings.title: Humanitarian Situation Report | 26 November 2026
findings.publisher: United Nations OCHA occupied Palestinian territory
findings.affected_population_system: Joint Distribution Consortium responded to 20 incident appeals affecting 430 households, 394 in Deir al-Balah; rapid assessments classified 219 households as high need. Incidents included displacement, strikes, fires, shelter collapse and strong winds. No new incident timing or individual harm count established.
findings.source_type: Official UN humanitarian situation report citing response partners

bounded_discovery_context.method: OCHA OPT first check; report humanitarian response section; compared against 43 authenticated prior ledger files.
bounded_discovery_context.novelty: Previously unlogged quantified incident-response burden, reporting period November 17–23, not events in the latest hour.
bounded_discovery_context.caveat: Specific incident dates unknown; no comparison with production.
